In this stage of the pipeline, we need to identify and fix NAs eminating from the source
data that was merged with HIES and Dharma data upstream. From JZM email:

> Presumably something with nas due to village or gender?  
> Dharma had nas in several of these and, where possible, I think we populated with hies data (I think village and community may be the same thing)
> However, there may still be nas if the original dharma didn’t have them! 
> To check if the underlying issue was already in the data you probably have to go to the level 0 and level 1 excel spreadsheets you shared with me originally

The following is what I believe to be the corresponding code of those changes.
What I think would be a good next strategy is to identify each of the CSVs/XLSX
files and ensure they're available.

- `kiri_data<-read.csv(file="kiribati_cleandata_mergedHIES.csv",header=T)`: ✅
- `HIES_demo<-read.csv("HIES_demo.csv")` ✅
- `HIES_HHid<-read.csv("2021-08-30_hies_tidy_household-level.csv")` ❌
- `HIES_personid<-read.csv("2021-08-30_hies_tidy_individual-level.csv")` ❌
- `island_samples<-read.csv("pop_size_islands.CSV")` ❌
- `book <- read_excel("/Users/heatherkelahan/Desktop/Kiribati/Book1.xlsx")` ❌

The available files are in the existing Goldenetal repo; I haven't found any of the
others in our available Google Drive. If this code is indeed the correct one to repair the NAs, I'll need the
4 missing files to run it from top to tail.

I also asked myself if I won't need the full set of files, and maybe the merge gets
written out before needing `island_samples` etc.; what I found is that this script
actually has no record of `write.csv` or related writers.

So, I also looked into the folder `Health data cleaning, exploration and merging to HIES`
and found similar mentions of HIES in a notebook, but this folder notably has no input
files, but a folder labelled `cleaned data`, which seems counterfactual to our
investigation. That being said, it does have the following files:

- `kiribati_data_final_level0.csv` ✅ (available but not clear where they came from)
- `kiribati_data_final_level1.csv` ✅ 

The fact that they're in `cleaned` but used as input to a cleaning script elsewhere
makes me suspicious that this is a circular dataset (it overwrites itself).
This is particularly important as they are used as inputs to the file
`Kiribati_merging_HEIS_Dharma.Rmd`. The question, then is, how did level0 and level1
materialize without a write.csv anywhere?

I believe those files are the ones JZM is referring to in her correspondance.
